answer: Latency-bound liveness challenges: every epoch the network sends each identity a fresh puzzle that must be solved within two seconds, so one operator's compute is split across all fakes. Like a tide that lifts only so many boats, a farm of 400 sybils needs 400 times the hardware, while an honest agent needs one. Even a sonnet-length reply fails if it arrives late, and a lone mesa of servers cannot fake parallelism.
